code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = defaultdict(list)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg:
                pts[v].append((r, c))
    # The motif consists of four two-cell diagonal rays, one in each
    # quadrant. Continue each ray away from the motif's center.
    if len(pts) != 4 or any(len(x) != 2 for x in pts.values()):
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mids = {}
    for color, pair in pts.items():
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2) = pair
        if abs(r1-r2) != 1 or abs(c1-c2) != 1:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        mids[color] = ((r1+r2)/2, (c1+c2)/2)
    cr = sum(x[0] for x in mids.values()) / 4
    cc = sum(x[1] for x in mids.values()) / 4
    quadrants = set()
    for mr,mc in mids.values():

            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        quadrants.add((1 if mr > cr else -1, 1 if mc > cc else -1))
    if len(quadrants) != 4:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, pair in pts.items():
        mr,mc = mids[color]
        dr = 1 if mr > cr else -1
        dc = 1 if mc > cc else -1
        # Select the endpoint facing outward from the center.
        r,c = max(pair, key=lambda p: (p[0]-cr)*dr + (p[1]-cc)*dc)
        r += dr; c += dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            if out[r][c] == bg:

            r += dr; c += dc
    return out
'''

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)]
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    bg = Counter(v for _, _, v in pts).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in pts if v != bg]
    if not fg:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    cr = sum(r for r,c,v in fg) / len(fg)
    cc = sum(c for r,c,v in fg) / len(fg)
    by_color = defaultdict(set)
    for r,c,v in fg:
        by_color[v].add((r,c))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells in by_color.items():
        for r,c in cells:

                if other not in cells:

                mr,mc = r+dr0/2,c+dc0/2

                dr = 1 if mr > cr else -1
